case_title.quote: SAT PARKASH v. STATE OF HARYANA AND ANOTHER

number_of_accused.quote: The conviction of the appellant upheld by the impugned order ... is liable to be set aside
number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided; the co-accused were already acquitted.

accused_gender.quote: his uncle - Hari Chand and aunt - Sarla
accused_gender.reason: The appellant is referred to as male.

accused_age.reason: The accused's age is not given.

victim_age.quote: Kumari Sushila alias Punam, a minor girl aged about 15 years
victim_age.reason: The charge states about 15 years, consistent with the birth date of 5.11.1976.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: I have loved Satto, and by dying I am leaving this writing as proof of my true love.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: The note shows an emotional attachment between the two.

offence_category.quote: kidnapped Kumari Sushila alias Punam ... under Section 363 IPC

statutory_provisions.quote: The surviving charges against the appellant are relatable only to Sections 363, 366, 366-A and 376
statutory_provisions.reason: Matches the charges and sections discussed, including 302/34 and 368.

weapon.reason: Poison is alleged in the charge and the value flags it as alleged.

evidence_type.quote: The dying declaration of Sushila indicates, that she had committed suicide
evidence_type.reason: The court itself calls the note a dying declaration.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Appellant acquitted of murder; convicted of some of the charges (headnote lists ss.363, 366, 366A, 368, 376), though the body says he was acquitted of s.376. Co-accused acquitted. Sentence not stated.
trial_court_outcome.reason: The headnote says s.376 conviction, but the body says acquitted of s.376. The value follows the headnote only.

high_court_outcome.quote: The conviction of the appellant upheld by the impugned order passed by the High Court
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court upheld the conviction (judgment dated 05.01.2011).

final_outcome.quote: The instant appeal is accordingly allowed.
final_outcome.reason: Conviction was set aside, so the accused is acquitted.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence remains after the conviction is set aside.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove the evaluative sentences, such as the prosecution producing no evidence of enticement or intercourse, as they hint at the outcome.
neutral_facts.quote: no other evidence had been produced by the prosecution, to demonstrate that Sat Parkash had enticed the deceased
neutral_facts.reason: The facts are mostly accurate, but the closing sentences about absent evidence leak the court's reasoning and outcome.

offence_severity.quote: punishable with imprisonment which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine
offence_severity.reason: Only s.366A punishment is quoted in the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: The alleged offences are completed ones.

physical_harm.quote: While in the attempt, Sushila had died, but somehow Sat Parkash survived.
physical_harm.reason: The victim died; the accused survived.

number_of_offences.reason: The charges against the accused are ss.363, 366A, 376 and 302/34, and no conviction stands.

motive.quote: with intent that said Sushila may be forced to illicit intercourse with you Sat Parkash
motive.reason: The motive is alleged in the charge and was not accepted.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: In view of the clear and unequivocal statement made by the deceased Sushila to the effect, that she had left her residence by her own free will
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The note was relied on; the date of birth was admitted and she was found at his residence.

post_offence_conduct.quote: the appellant- Sat Parkash, had also made a similar attempt to commit along with Sushila
post_offence_conduct.reason: The suicide attempt is noted as undisputed.

bail_history.quote: By this Court's motion Bench order dated 15.04.2011, the appellant was enlarged on bail.

trial_duration.quote: charged with the following, by the Additional Sessions Judge, Sonepat on 18.10.1993
trial_duration.reason: Dates match the judgment; the trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: Anoop G. Chaudhary, Sr.Adv., Suresh C. Gupta, Birendra K. Mishra, Ms. Poonam Atey

investigation_status.quote: The charges depicted in the charge sheet
investigation_status.reason: A charge sheet was filed, charges were framed, and the trial was completed.

procedural_irregularity.quote: there was no express charge against the appellant under the above provision
procedural_irregularity.reason: The court considered s.366 on its own although it was not charged.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: appellant acquitted of murder, convicted on other charges (body says acquitted of s.376); High Court upheld conviction; Supreme Court allowed appeal and set aside conviction.
appeal_history.reason: The overall history is right, but the s.376 conviction at trial conflicts with the body text.

defence_argument.quote: learned counsel for the appellant relied on the "suicide note" executed by the deceased
defence_argument.reason: Reliance on the suicide note is the recorded defence argument.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the inducing of the minor to constitute an offence under Section 366A, should have been with reference to an intent to force or seduce her
legal_principle_applied.reason: Section-wise ingredient analysis matches the judgment.

other_sentence_order.quote: His bail bonds shall stand discharged.
